# #465 Vi lanserar för- och efterhandel i USA

**Feed**: avanzapodden  
**Published**: 2026-09-08  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Episode 465 of the Avanza podcast is US-themed, marking the launch of pre-market and after-hours US trading on the platform, with extensive discussion of US market macro (strong US jobs data of 162k, fears of Fed/ECB/BoJ rate hikes, oil spike on Iran/Hormuz tensions) and September's reputation as a weak seasonal month. The hosts run through US superinvestor buy-lists (heavy Mag7/AI-infrastructure), dividend-growth names, and 2026 S&P 500 winners (hardware/AI/memory like Sandisk +633%, Moderna, Dell) and losers (SaaS/health like The Trade Desk -62%). A guest analyst from Affärsvärlden gives a BUY on BHG Group (~50% upside) and a NEUTRAL/hold on Sagax.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 BHG — BHG Group | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Affärsvärlden/Placera buy rating; stock down 37% YTD on overblown expectations while operations improve, debt falls, growth returns.

#### Reasoning

Analyst argues the drop reflects too-high expectations at year-end rather than deteriorating fundamentals. Organic growth resumed (7% H1), debt is falling toward 2x EBITDA target, and margins should climb from 4% to 5% target. At a modest 9x EBIT this implies nearly 50% upside. Structural online tailwind (~20% category penetration) supports growth.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin fails to improve from 4% toward 5%
- if organic growth reverses
- if net debt rises back above target
- if consumer/discretionary demand weakens further

> *"sätter man bara en måttlig värdering på det där, till exempel 9 gånger rörelsevinsten givet att de klarar det där klivet då. Då är det nästan 50 procents uppsida i aktien"*

---

### 🟡 SAGA-B — Sagax | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Affärsvärlden neutral rating; large warehouse/light-industry property owner, down 10% YTD, high direct yield but no strong catalyst.

#### Reasoning

Analyst assigns a neutral rating to Sagax, one of the largest property companies on the Stockholm exchange, focused on warehouses and light industry outside city centers with small assets and relatively high direct yield. No clear directional conviction was expressed beyond a hold stance.

#### Sell Triggers

- if interest rates rise sharply
- if occupancy/rental values in warehouse segment weaken

> *"Sagax som ni skrev om första gången den här tredje september. Där har ni satt ett neutralt råd"*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Superinvestors are net buyers of Nvidia while general Avanza customers have it on the most-sold list; hosts infer superinvestors see more upside.

#### Reasoning

The hosts note a divergence: Avanza's outperforming 'superinvestors' are net-buying Nvidia whereas the broad customer base is net-selling it. Their interpretation is that the smart-money cohort believes there is more to gain, aligning with continued belief that AI infrastructure keeps growing. This is a host observation, not a formal recommendation, hence low conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI-infrastructure capex expectations roll over
- if superinvestor positioning flips to selling

> *"Superinvesterarna tror alltså att det finns mer att hämta i Nvidia. Ska vi tolka det så? Det är så jag hade tolkat det i alla fall."*

---
